cues.en: Let's continue with our Dockerfile from where we had left off in the previous lecture.
cues.zh: 繼續編寫上一堂課尚未完成的 Dockerfile。

cues.en: So after building our dependency and sub dependency wheels institution, we can now set up a stage two.
cues.zh: 第一階段建置完相依套件與次級相依套件的 wheel，現在設定第二階段。

cues.en: As you can add a comment right here.
cues.zh: 在這裡加入註解，

cues.en: And you can see this is stage two.
cues.zh: 標示 Stage 2。

cues.en: So in stage two of our multistage build this is going to be the Python run stage.
cues.zh: 多階段建置的第二階段，就是 Python 執行階段。

cues.en: And at this stage we want to run our application.
cues.zh: 這個階段要執行應用程式。

cues.en: So I can just call this stage Python run stage like that.
cues.zh: 所以將它命名為 python-run-stage。

cues.en: Then we're going to first begin our stage with the from statement like we've seen before.
cues.zh: 和之前一樣，先用 FROM 開始這個階段。

cues.en: So you can say from Python which is our alias.
cues.zh: 輸入 FROM python，也就是剛才的別名。

cues.en: Now we can create another alias for this stage that is going to be as we can call this Python run stage.
cues.zh: 再用 AS python-run-stage，建立這個階段的別名。

cues.en: Then we're going to define our application arguments.
cues.zh: 接著定義應用程式參數。

cues.en: So the first one is going to be app home.
cues.zh: 第一個是 APP_HOME。

cues.en: And this is the directory in our container where our application shall live.
cues.zh: 這是容器中存放應用程式的目錄。

cues.en: So you can see our app home.
cues.zh: 設定 APP_HOME，

cues.en: That's going to be slash src.
cues.zh: 值是 /src。

cues.en: Then we're going to have another argument.
cues.zh: 接著再加一個參數，

cues.en: And this is going to be for the app underscore user.
cues.zh: 叫 APP_USER。

cues.en: That's going to be a fast API.
cues.zh: 值是 fastapi。

cues.en: So this is the user who will run the application.
cues.zh: 也就是執行應用程式的使用者。

cues.en: Then we can have another argument and that's going to be up group, and this is going to be the group that the user belongs to.
cues.zh: 再加 APP_GROUP 參數，表示使用者所屬的群組。

cues.en: And we can call the group a fast API.
cues.zh: 群組也叫 fastapi。

cues.en: So for the app user and the app group, you can name it whatever you want.
cues.zh: APP_USER 與 APP_GROUP 的名稱可以自行決定。

cues.en: And I'll explain why we need these two arguments later on.
cues.zh: 稍後會解釋為什麼需要這兩個參數。

cues.en: Then we can now set the environment variables by saying env.
cues.zh: 接著使用 ENV 設定環境變數。

cues.en: The key is going to be Python.
cues.zh: 鍵名先寫 PYTHON，

cues.en: Then don't right.
cues.zh: 接著 DONTWRITE，

cues.en: Make sure you get the spelling correctly bytecode like that.
cues.zh: 確認拼字正確，再接 BYTECODE。

cues.en: And we're going to set the value to one.
cues.zh: 值設為 1。

cues.en: So basically by setting Python don't write bytecode to one.
cues.zh: 將 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE 設為 1，

cues.en: We are preventing Python from writing dot pyc files which are compiled bytecode files to our disk.
cues.zh: 會防止 Python 把 .pyc，也就是編譯後的位元組碼檔寫入磁碟。

cues.en: This is useful for reducing the size of the final Docker image.
cues.zh: 有助於縮小最終 Docker 映像檔。

cues.en: Then to have our directive run in multiple lines.
cues.zh: 要讓這個指示分成多行，

cues.en: The backslash.
cues.zh: 加入反斜線，

cues.en: Then enter.
cues.zh: 再按 Enter，

cues.en: Then you can type it in.
cues.zh: 然後縮排。

cues.en: We're going to set another environment variable of Python unbuffered.
cues.zh: 接著設定另一個環境變數 PYTHONUNBUFFERED。

cues.en: Make sure you get the spelling correctly and set it to one.
cues.zh: 確認拼字正確，值設為 1。

cues.en: So Python unbuffered with the value of one prevents Python from buffering the output.
cues.zh: PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 會防止 Python 緩衝輸出。

cues.en: This means that the output will be sent directly to the console or the terminal without any buffering, thus allowing some real time output.
cues.zh: 也就是直接將輸出傳到主控台或終端機，不經過緩衝，讓輸出即時顯示。

cues.en: Then, after setting the environment variables, we're going to set the working directory to the application home directory in our container.
cues.zh: 環境變數設定好後，將工作目錄設為容器中的應用程式主目錄。

cues.en: As you can see, Workdir and our working directory is going to be our argument that we created up above of up home.
cues.zh: 使用 WORKDIR，傳入上面建立的 APP_HOME 參數。

cues.en: So we basically want our container, the working directory to be slash src as we've defined it in our app home argument.
cues.zh: 我們要讓容器的工作目錄是 /src，就是 APP_HOME 的設定值。

cues.en: Then after setting the working directory we're going to install some system dependencies by using the run command.
cues.zh: 設定好工作目錄後，用 RUN 安裝系統相依套件。

cues.en: As you can see run apt get update and apt get install then dash dash no then hyphen install, then hyphen
cues.zh: 輸入 RUN apt-get update && apt-get install，再加 --no-install，

cues.en: recommends.
cues.zh: 接上 -recommends。

cues.en: We have seen that before.
cues.zh: 之前已經看過。

cues.en: Dash y then backslash.
cues.zh: 再加 -y 與反斜線。

cues.en: Then we're going to install the sudo package so that we can run commands with elevated privileges in our container.
cues.zh: 接著安裝 sudo 套件，以便在容器中用較高權限執行命令。

cues.en: As you can see sudo then we're also going to install git the version control system.
cues.zh: 加入 sudo，再安裝版本控制系統 git。

cues.en: Then we're going to install bash then hyphen completion and bash completion.
cues.zh: 接著安裝 bash-completion。

cues.en: Install the supports for the bash shell command Autocompletion.
cues.zh: 它會安裝 Bash Shell 命令的自動補完支援。

cues.en: Then we're going to install nano in our container and nano installs the nano text editor.
cues.zh: 再安裝 nano，也就是 Nano 文字編輯器。

cues.en: Then we can install SSH which is Secure Shell.
cues.zh: 接著安裝 ssh，也就是 Secure Shell。

cues.en: And we're going to be using SSH for secure remote access and file transfer then backslash.
cues.zh: 會用 SSH 進行安全的遠端存取與檔案傳輸，再加反斜線。

cues.en: Then we're going to install get text.
cues.zh: 接著安裝 gettext。

cues.en: And this get text just basically provides internationalization and localization support.
cues.zh: gettext 基本上提供國際化與在地化支援。

cues.en: Then backslash.
cues.zh: 再加反斜線。

cues.en: Then we're going to clean up and used files by saying and apt get purge then dash y then dash dash auto
cues.zh: 接著清理不再使用的檔案，寫 && apt-get purge -y --auto，

cues.en: then hyphen remove then dash oh then space, then apt, then a full colon twice double colon.
cues.zh: 再接 -remove -o，接著空格與 APT，再加雙冒號。

cues.en: Like that we can say auto remove, then double colon like that.
cues.zh: 接著 AutoRemove，再加雙冒號。

cues.en: Then recommends important and set that to false like that.
cues.zh: 然後 RecommendsImportant，設為 false。

cues.en: So let me explain what's going on here.
cues.zh: 解釋一下這裡的作用。

cues.en: So all this statement that you've written here, this command basically removes any unnecessary packages and clean up the package cache.
cues.zh: 這整段命令基本上會移除不必要套件，並清理套件快取。

cues.en: See if I can explain it individually.
cues.zh: 分開解釋的話，

cues.en: The purge patch option removes packages along with the configuration files, then the auto remove or flag.
cues.zh: purge 會連同設定檔一起移除套件；--auto-remove，

cues.en: This removes unused dependencies and packages that are automatically installed but are no longer needed then.
cues.zh: 則會移除自動安裝、但目前已不需要的相依套件。

cues.en: So with all this, this flag basically tells up to get to treat recommended packages as an important when deciding which packages to auto remove, allowing for an aggressive cleanup.
cues.zh: 這個選項告訴 apt-get，判斷自動移除哪些套件時，不要將 recommended 套件視為重要項目，讓清理更徹底。

cues.en: Then after that backslash again, then we're now going to remove the package list files, which is no longer needed after the packages have been installed.
cues.zh: 接著再加反斜線，移除套件安裝完成後不再需要的套件清單檔。

cues.en: So you can see and rm rf var then lib, then slash apt then slash then slash star like that.
cues.zh: 寫 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*。

cues.en: Then after the run command, we're going to implementing some security best practices.
cues.zh: RUN 命令之後，實作一些安全性最佳實務。

cues.en: And we're going to be doing that by creating a non-root user and a group for running the application.
cues.zh: 建立非 root 使用者與群組，用來執行應用程式。

cues.en: This is because by default, Docker containers run as the root user, which is a security risk.
cues.zh: 因為 Docker 容器預設以 root 使用者執行，這有安全風險。

cues.en: And remember, the root user in a Unix environment has access to all the files and directories in the container for the kind of application we're building, We want to ensure that our containers run with
cues.zh: 記得，在 Unix 環境中，root 可存取容器內所有檔案與目錄。對我們正在建置的應用程式而言，希望容器以

cues.en: minimal necessary permissions, rather than running as the root user.
cues.zh: 最低必要權限執行，而非 root。

cues.en: So how do you do that?
cues.zh: 該怎麼做？

cues.en: We're going to say run.
cues.zh: 使用 RUN。

cues.en: Then we can use the group command.
cues.zh: 接著使用 groupadd 命令。

cues.en: So group add then dash R.
cues.zh: 輸入 groupadd -r。

cues.en: Then we're going to pass in our group that we had created as an argument up above of app group then and then backslash like that.
cues.zh: 傳入上面建立的 APP_GROUP 參數，再加 && 與反斜線。

cues.en: And so this group add dash R creates a system group.
cues.zh: groupadd -r 會建立系統群組。

cues.en: And we're going to pass in our app group argument as the group name.
cues.zh: 使用 APP_GROUP 參數作為群組名稱。

cues.en: Then after group and we can say user add dash R then dash g.
cues.zh: 接著寫 useradd -r -g。

cues.en: Then we're going to pass in our app group like that, then dash D, then we're going to pass in our app home.
cues.zh: 傳入 APP_GROUP，再接 -d，傳入 APP_HOME。

cues.en: Then dash M, we're going to pass in our user like that.
cues.zh: 接著 -m，再傳入 APP_USER。

cues.en: So let me explain what's going on here.
cues.zh: 解釋一下。

cues.en: So user add dash R.
cues.zh: useradd -r，

cues.en: This will create our system user then G app group.
cues.zh: 建立系統使用者；-g APP_GROUP，

cues.en: This assigns the user to the group that we had just created.
cues.zh: 則將使用者加入剛才建立的群組。

cues.en: And remember our app group was also called a fast API.
cues.zh: 記得，APP_GROUP 也叫 fastapi。

cues.en: Then the Dash D app home.
cues.zh: -d APP_HOME，

cues.en: This one sets the home directory.
cues.zh: 設定家目錄。

cues.en: In our case our home directory is going to be slash src.
cues.zh: 這裡的家目錄是 /src，

cues.en: Like we defined up above.
cues.zh: 就和上面定義的一樣。

cues.en: Then the dash m.
cues.zh: 接著是 -m。

cues.en: This one creates the user's home directory if it doesn't exist.
cues.zh: 如果使用者家目錄不存在，就會建立。

cues.en: So the user's home directory is going to be the app user.
cues.zh: 接著指定使用者，也就是 APP_USER。

cues.en: And our app user is our first API like that.
cues.zh: APP_USER 是 fastapi。

cues.en: Then after that we're going to create the logs directory and set permissions.
cues.zh: 接著建立 logs 目錄，並設定權限。

cues.en: Remember when we're testing out our logs I told you to delete the logs directory because we're going to be creating it using Docker.
cues.zh: 記得測試日誌時，我請你刪除 logs 目錄，因為要透過 Docker 建立。

cues.en: So this is the time to do that.
cues.zh: 現在就來處理。

cues.en: So what you're going to do here we're going to say run then make the Dash B in our app home.
cues.zh: 寫 RUN mkdir -p，路徑從 APP_HOME 開始。

cues.en: We're going to have the logs directory in our app home which is slash src then slash backend then slash app, then slash logs like that.
cues.zh: logs 目錄放在 APP_HOME，也就是 /src 底下，再接 /backend/app/logs。

cues.en: Then and then backslash.
cues.zh: 接著加 && 與反斜線。

cues.en: We're going to set the permissions for the logs directory by saying chmod then 775 on app home slash
cues.zh: 再用 chmod 775 設定日誌目錄權限，路徑是 APP_HOME，

cues.en: backend, then slash app, then slash logs like that.
cues.zh: 再接 /backend/app/logs。

cues.en: So the 775 permissions means.
cues.zh: 775 權限的意思是，

cues.en: So the first seven means the owner has read, write and execute permissions.
cues.zh: 第一個 7 表示擁有者有讀取、寫入與執行權限。

cues.en: In a Unix system, we shall have permissions in terms of read, write and execute, and each one is given a numerical value of four comma two comma one like that.
cues.zh: Unix 系統的讀取、寫入與執行權限，各有數值 4、2、1。

cues.en: So four is for read.
cues.zh: 4 代表讀取。

cues.en: Then write is two, then execute is one.
cues.zh: 2 代表寫入，1 代表執行。

cues.en: Aside from this we have the owner permissions, the group permissions and the other permissions.
cues.zh: 另外還分為擁有者、群組與其他人的權限。

cues.en: So when you're seeing 775 we mean 4 or 4 read, then two for write and then one.
cues.zh: 所以 775 裡，先看讀取 4、寫入 2，以及執行 1。

cues.en: So four plus two plus one is seven.
So the owner has read, write and execute permissions.
cues.zh: 表示擁有者可讀取、寫入與執行。

cues.en: Then aside from the owner the second seven here this is for the group.
cues.zh: 擁有者之外，第二個 7 是群組權限。

cues.en: And for the group also has seven meaning it has read, write and execute permissions and then others.
cues.zh: 群組也是 7，代表可讀取、寫入與執行。接著是其他人，

cues.en: Others is no five meaning they only have read and execute permissions.
cues.zh: 其他人是 5，代表只有讀取與執行權限。

cues.en: That is read which is four plus execute which is one.
cues.zh: 也就是讀取 4，加上執行 1。

cues.en: So four plus one is five.
And for example, since others have no write permissions, write is just zero.
cues.zh: 例如其他人沒有寫入權限，寫入就是 0。

cues.en: So it is just four plus one which is five.
Then write is zero.
cues.zh: 寫入為 0。

cues.en: So that's how permissions basically work in a Unix environment.
cues.zh: 這就是 Unix 環境中權限的基本運作方式。

cues.en: And remember we are setting our permissions to seven seven, five because our app needs the full access to write logs to the logs directory.
cues.zh: 記得，設定成 775，是因為應用程式需要完整存取權，才能將日誌寫入 logs 目錄。

cues.en: Group members need full access for maintenance purposes, and other members only need to read and execute permissions for monitoring purposes.
cues.zh: 群組成員需要完整權限進行維護，其他人則只需讀取與執行，供監控使用。

cues.en: Then, after creating our logs and setting up the permissions, we're going to copy the Python dependency and sub dependency wheels from our previous build stage.
cues.zh: 建立日誌目錄並設定權限後，從先前建置階段複製 Python 相依套件與次級相依套件的 wheel。

cues.en: So you can see copy then the source.
cues.zh: 使用 COPY，指定來源。

cues.en: We can say dash dash from and the stage we want to copy from is our Python build stage.
cues.zh: 加上 --from，來源階段是 python-build-stage。

cues.en: So we want to copy from that stage slash user then slash src then slash app then wheels then slash wheels like that.
cues.zh: 從該階段的 /usr/src/app/wheels，複製到 /wheels。

cues.en: And this is one of the advantages of using multi-stage builds, because you can copy artifacts from one stage to another.
cues.zh: 這就是多階段建置的優點之一，可以把產出檔從一個階段複製到另一階段。

cues.en: As you can see, we're copying our wheels from the build stage and using them in our run stage right here like that.
cues.zh: 這裡就是將建置階段的 wheel，複製到執行階段使用。

cues.en: And that basically marks it for this lecture.
cues.zh: 這堂課就到這裡。

cues.en: In the next lecture, we're still going to continue with our Dockerfile.
cues.zh: 下一堂課繼續編寫 Dockerfile。

cues.en: There's still a lot to be done.
cues.zh: 還有很多內容要做。
